name: @workbench/cli
description: Shared agentic software-development context, records, and change gates

scripts.maintenance:plan: pnpm run tooling:maintainers && node scripts/maintenance/main.mjs plan
scripts.maintenance:apply: pnpm run tooling:maintainers && node scripts/maintenance/main.mjs apply
scripts.format:check: node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --check "app/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,css}" "app/test/**/*.{ts,mts}" app/test/tsconfig.json "scripts/**/*.mts" scripts/*-assets.json scripts/bootstrap-tools.json scripts/ci-actions.json scripts/package-manager/*.json scripts/container-tools/*.json "examples/**/managed-release-check.json" "examples/**/release-musl.json" "examples/**/.mvn/*.json" ".devcontainer/**/*.json" "examples/**/scripts/*.mts" bin/*.mjs bin/*.cts package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mts vitest.config.mts .prettierrc.json .pnpmfile.cjs
scripts.format: node node_modules/prettier/bin/prettier.cjs --write "app/src/**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,css}" "app/test/**/*.{ts,mts}" app/test/tsconfig.json "scripts/**/*.mts" scripts/*-assets.json scripts/bootstrap-tools.json scripts/ci-actions.json scripts/package-manager/*.json scripts/container-tools/*.json "examples/**/managed-release-check.json" "examples/**/release-musl.json" "examples/**/.mvn/*.json" ".devcontainer/**/*.json" "examples/**/scripts/*.mts" bin/*.mjs bin/*.cts package.json tsconfig.json eslint.config.mts vitest.config.mts .prettierrc.json .pnpmfile.cjs
scripts.test: pnpm run tooling:maintainers && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.check: node scripts/setup-development.mts --reuse-prepared && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run format:check && node scripts/check-lint.mts && node scripts/check-bundle.mts && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run
scripts.release: pnpm run tooling:build && pnpm run typecheck && node scripts/package-workbench.mjs
scripts.bundle:build: pnpm run tooling:build && pnpm run typecheck && node scripts/build-bundle.mjs
scripts.maintenance:resume: pnpm run tooling:maintainers && node scripts/maintenance/main.mjs apply --refresh-locks --resume
